title: Graded exactness implies strict exactness for finite filtered objects
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $X\xrightarrow{u}Y\xrightarrow{v}Z$ be filtration-preserving maps of finitely decreasingly filtered objects [def-sp-filtration], with $vu=0$. A map $f:M\to N$ is called strict if $f(F^pM)=\operatorname{im}(f)\cap F^pN$ for every integer $p$. Suppose $\operatorname{gr}^pX\to\operatorname{gr}^pY\to\operatorname{gr}^pZ$ is exact for every $p$. Then $u$ and $v$ are strict, $X\to Y\to Z$ is exact, and for every $p$ both $F^pX\to F^pY\to F^pZ$ and $X/F^pX\to Y/F^pY\to Z/F^pZ$ are exact.

proof.text: Choose common integers $a\le b$ with $F^aT=T$ and $F^bT=0$ for $T=X,Y,Z$, by taking $a$ to be the minimum of the three whole-object bounds and $b$ the maximum of $a$ and the three zero bounds [def-sp-filtration]. Put $K=(X\xrightarrow{u}Y\xrightarrow{v}Z)$ in cochain degrees $0,1,2$, zero elsewhere. The equation $vu=0$ makes this a complex, and preservation of filtrations makes each $F^pK$ a subcomplex. Its quotient $K/F^pK$ and $\operatorname{gr}^pK=F^pK/F^{p+1}K$ have the termwise quotient objects and induced differentials: the square-zero identity descends from $vu=0$. In all these three-term complexes, $H^1$ means the quotient of the kernel of the second map by the image of the first. Thus the hypothesis says $H^1(\operatorname{gr}^pK)=0$ for every integer $p$.

For each p use the short complexes of restrictions and graded maps. The successive inclusions and cokernel projections give a degreewise short exact extension F^(p+1)K → F^pK → gr^pK. Prove exactness of the middle complex by the direct diagram chase exact_extension: lift a quotient boundary after an epimorphic refinement, subtract it, factor the difference through the monic subcomplex, and lift there using exactness. Descending finite induction starts at the zero bound for Y. Underlying exactness follows from step exactness at a common whole-object bound for X and Y, by ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono.

source.place: Tag 05QH (lemma-filtered-acyclic), parts (2), (5); its filtration induction made explicit using Tag 0117 (lemma-long-exact-sequence-cochain)

proof.text: Construct gr^pK → K/F^(p+1)K and K/F^(p+1)K → K/F^pK by cokernel descent. The first map is monic: lift a generalized element of its kernel after an epimorphic refinement and factor it through F^(p+1), so its graded class is zero. Their exactness follows by lifting a quotient cycle and factoring through F^p. The transition is epi since its composite with the cokernel projection is epi. Apply exact_extension and ascending finite induction from the whole-object bound for Y; the middle quotient is zero below that bound. This proves exactness of every quotient short complex.

source.place: Tag 05QH (lemma-filtered-acyclic), part (3); finite quotient induction using Tag 0117 (lemma-long-exact-sequence-cochain)

proof.text: For strictness of u, the restricted image lies in im(u) intersect F^pY. The inclusion of this intersection in F^pY is killed by the restricted v, since vu=0. Step exactness lifts it through the restricted u after an epimorphic refinement. Precomposing with an epimorphism does not change an image subobject, giving the reverse inequality.

source.place: Tag 05QH (lemma-filtered-acyclic), part (4), strictness of the first map

proof.text: For strictness of v let P=im(v) intersect F^pZ. Lift its inclusion through v after an epimorphic refinement, using the epi image factorization. Its class in Y/F^pY is a cycle. Quotient exactness and another epi refinement lift this class through the induced u; lift that quotient class to X after a third refinement. Subtract its u-image from the lift in Y. The difference is killed by the quotient projection, hence factors through F^pY. Its v-image still equals the original inclusion of P after the composite epimorphic refinement, because vu=0. Images are unchanged by epi precomposition, so P lies in v(F^pY). The reverse inclusion follows from filtration preservation.

lean.statement: theorem finite_filtered_graded_exactness {X Y Z : FilteredObject C} (u : X ⟶ Y) (v : Y ⟶ Z) (hvu : u.hom ≫ v.hom = 0) (hX : DecreasingFiltration.IsFinite X.filtration) (hY : DecreasingFiltration.IsFinite Y.filtration) (hZ : DecreasingFiltration.IsFinite Z.filtration) (hgr : ∀ p : ℤ, (ShortComplex.mk (gradedMapSteps u p) (gradedMapSteps v p) (gradedMapSteps_comp u v hvu p)).Exact) : FilteredObject.IsStrict u ∧ FilteredObject.IsStrict v ∧ (ShortComplex.mk u.hom v.hom hvu).Exact ∧ (∀ p : ℤ, (ShortComplex.mk (restrictionSteps u p) (restrictionSteps v p) (restrictionSteps_comp u v hvu p)).Exact ∧ (ShortComplex.mk (quotientMap u p) (quotientMap v p) (quotientMap_comp u v hvu p)).Exact)
